item.title: Website Builder Pricing: Webflow vs Framer — Free Plans, First Paid Steps and Site Limits, Checked Against Official Pricing
item.description: Webflow's free Starter caps a site at 2 static pages, 1 GB of bandwidth and 50 form submissions, and its first paid Site plan is Basic at $15 per month billed yearly. Framer's free plan includes 10 CMS collections and 1,000 pages but no custom domain, per its pricing FAQ. Checked November 14, 2026.
